simple.meaning: יָצַב (yâtsab) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to place (any thing so as to stay); reflexively, to station , offer , continue.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 48 times across Exodus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Joshua, Judges, and 10 more, beginning at Exodus 2:4. Its contexts include family, land, mountain, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to יָצַב (H3320).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: יָצַב (yâtsab) / H3320 is traced through Exodus 2:4, Exodus 8:16, Exodus 9:13, Exodus 14:13 as a generated source-based concept entry.
